note: Indicative Maharashtra stamp duty and registration rules. Percentages follow the commonly published structure (local-body-wise stamp duty, metro cess in notified cities, 1% registration capped at Rs 30,000, 1% female-buyer rebate). Rules change in the state budget — verify the current rate at the IGR Maharashtra registration office before any transaction.
